world.title: 'First time in long time, we're maybe close to deal': Donald Trump on Ukraine conflict
world.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that the United States might be nearing a peace deal regarding the Ukraine conflict, marking a significant development. He also expressed openness to a high-level meeting with Russia and China to discuss denuclearization, calling such discussions a positive step. However, Trump did not confirm the likelihood of these meetings taking place.

world.title: Indian Embassy issues advisory amid France protests as Macron slams Trump
world.summary: The Indian Embassy in Paris has issued an advisory for Indian nationals in France, urging them to remain vigilant and avoid protest areas amid ongoing violent protests and clashes. The advisory comes as fresh rallies and a nationwide strike threaten to escalate unrest over living costs. Localized curfews have also been imposed following recent disturbances.

world.title: Pak, Turkiye, Qatar, Indonesia sign def pact, experts say ‘Badr MoU’ won’t put New Delhi
world.summary: Turkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed the 'Badr Memorandum of Understanding' in Doha to enhance defense cooperation. Experts, including Sudhir Kumar Mishra, expressed that this agreement is unlikely to jeopardize India's recent defense deals with Indonesia concerning advanced weaponry. The focus remains on strengthening regional defense ties without significantly impacting existing agreements between India and Indonesia.

business.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
business.summary: Meta is planning to create a new class of non-voting stock to finance its extensive investments in artificial intelligence. This strategy aims to support the company's ambitious AI initiatives as it reported its third-quarter earnings. The introduction of this stock type is part of Meta's broader effort to enhance its AI models and services.

business.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25 billion in trial related to 8-year-old data privacy scandal
business.summary: A New Mexico state court has mandated that Meta, the parent company of Facebook, pay a $25 billion penalty. This ruling is a result of a prolonged legal dispute related to the Cambridge Analytica data privacy scandal, which occurred nearly eight years ago. The judgment highlights ongoing concerns regarding data privacy and corporate accountability in the tech industry.

business.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in data misuse case linked to Trump's 2016 campaign
business.summary: Meta has been ordered to pay $25 billion in a New Mexico case related to data misuse by Cambridge Analytica during Donald Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign. The now-defunct firm acquired personal information from millions of Facebook accounts without user consent for voter profiling and targeting. This ruling highlights ongoing legal repercussions surrounding data privacy and electoral practices.

technology.title: Strands Hint Today: Answers for Oct. 21, No. 962
technology.summary: The NYT Strands puzzle No. 962 for October 21, 2026, features a theme related to items commonly stored away in homes. The article provides hints, including the spangram, and lists all answers for today’s puzzle. This information is intended to assist players in solving the Strands puzzle effectively and enhance their overall experience.

technology.title: Uncovering Chemical Threats and Narcotics in the Field
technology.summary: Handheld chemical analyzers enhance the identification of narcotics and chemical threats, enabling field response teams to make safer and more efficient decisions. Industry expert Mike Bates discusses their role in supporting law enforcement, hazmat, and customs operations. These devices facilitate quicker threat identification and bolster confidence in responses, ultimately improving safety and effectiveness in critical situations.

sports.title: Aussies provide update on Smith for final day of second Test
sports.summary: Australia anticipates that Steve Smith will be ready to bat on the final day of the second Test against South Africa in Gqeberha. Smith did not bat late on the fourth day due to injury concerns, but the team remains optimistic about his fitness. Australia aims to secure a draw in the match as they face South Africa.

sports.title: How to watch IND vs NZ T20I 2026 live: Start time, TV channels and streaming details for India tour of New Zealand
sports.summary: India will start a five-match T20I series against New Zealand on October 22, 2026. Fans can watch the matches live through various TV channels and streaming platforms. Specific details regarding start times and broadcasting options will be provided to ensure viewers can follow the series. This information is essential for those interested in watching the games live.

sports.title: Mikel Arteta provides worrying Bukayo Saka update after Arsenal star forced off
sports.summary: Bukayo Saka was substituted due to injury just 10 minutes into Arsenal's 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich in the Champions League. Manager Mikel Arteta expressed concern over Saka's condition, highlighting the potential impact on the team. The extent of the injury remains unclear, and further assessments will determine Saka's availability for upcoming matches.

health.title: Why AI Must Contextualize, Not Automate, Crisis Hotlines
health.summary: NeuroFlow SVP Jeremy Kreyling emphasizes the importance of contextualizing AI in crisis hotlines rather than automating responses. He argues that AI should synthesize patient context before outreach, while advocating against the use of voice AI in these sensitive situations. The role of hotline responders, typically clinicians, is crucial for providing immediate support to members identified as at risk.

health.title: You don’t need 10,000 steps a day to protect your heart
health.summary: A new cardiology statement indicates that walking 7,000 steps daily may provide most heart health benefits, challenging the common 10,000-step guideline. Research shows significant health advantages can be achieved with lower step counts. This finding suggests that individuals aiming for better cardiovascular health may not need to reach the higher target, making exercise more accessible.

health.title: Urinary haloacetic acid concentrations and asthenozoospermia risk: a case-control study in China
health.summary: A case-control study in China investigated the association between urinary haloacetic acids (HAAs) and asthenozoospermia risk. Analyzing 135 cases and 270 controls, higher levels of trichloroacetic acid (TCAA) and dichloroacetic acid (DCAA) were linked to increased risk. Co-exposure to both compounds showed a 2.62-fold higher risk, indicating significant joint effects on male reproductive health.

science.title: Study finds solar system may destabilize within 3 billion years
science.summary: A recent study indicates that the Solar System may destabilize within 3 billion years, significantly sooner than previously believed. As the Sun ages and transitions to a white dwarf, it will lose mass in unpredictable bursts, potentially disrupting the gravitational balance that maintains planetary orbits. This finding challenges established views regarding the long-term stability of our Solar System.

science.title: JWST detects heavy elements near Milky Way’s central black hole
science.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope has identified heavy elements in gas surrounding Sagittarius A*, the supermassive black hole at the Milky Way's center. This discovery indicates that the composition of the detected gas closely resembles that of nearby stars. The findings contribute to understanding the chemical environment around black holes and the processes influencing star formation in the galaxy.

science.title: An affinity for warm climes has helped crocs thrive for eons
science.summary: Crocodilians, including modern crocodiles, alligators, caimans, and gharials, have thrived for over 240 million years. Recent research highlights their affinity for warm climates as a key factor in their evolutionary success. This adaptability has allowed them to survive various environmental changes and challenges throughout history, contributing to their status as one of the most enduring groups of reptiles.

entertainment.title: From Kerala to the Victoria’s Secret runway: Why Ravleen Varghese is making waves in international media
entertainment.summary: Ravleen Varghese, a 25-year-old model from Kodumon, Kerala, made history by walking the runway at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show in Los Angeles on October 18. She is the first Malayali model to participate in the iconic event. Varghese's journey in fashion began at 18 while studying at the National Institute of Fashion Technology in New Delhi.
